summary: An acid groovebox firmware that keeps the ATEK303 bass-line track and adds a 64-step drum track in the style of the TR-808, 909 and 707, both generated from seeds and sharing one clock.
features: Unchanged ATEK303 1.2 track with drive, chorus, delay and reverb
Eight synthesized drum voices, no samples; 808, 909 and 707 kits
Seeded groove generator with layered mutations and LOCK
8 x 16 step matrix editor, swing, drum length independent of the 303
Drum notes sent as GM notes over USB MIDI
Not yet tested on a real FM-1; ATEK303 1.2 presets don't load
